corrected_rule.official_reference: sqrt(Pantheon+SH0ES_STAT+SYS.cov diagonal at official catalog row)

reader_explanation_correction.fixed_readme_description: The frozen README describes m_b_corr_err_DIAG as a covariance-diagonal uncertainty.
reader_explanation_correction.observed_numerical_relation: The printed m_b_corr_err_DIAG values do not numerically equal sqrt of the printed STAT+SYS covariance diagonal; H0DN err_m_b matches the latter to H0DN print precision.

reason: The H0DN printed err_m_b values reproduce the square roots of the official printed STAT+SYS covariance diagonal to the H0DN table's five-decimal resolution. The frozen README describes m_b_corr_err_DIAG as covariance-diagonal-derived, but its printed values do not numerically equal those square roots. The cause of this documentation/data discrepancy is unresolved here.
